# langsmith_auth_server (Resource)

Manages a workspace-scoped OAuth auth server. Import with `<id>` or `<workspace_id>/<id>`. Client secrets and token request headers are never returned by the API and cannot be recovered on import. They remain in sensitive Terraform state; use encrypted remote state. Deleting an auth server also deletes its connections.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "langsmith_auth_server" "example" {
  workspace_id               = "your-workspace-id"
  slug                       = "example-oauth"
  display_name               = "Example OAuth"
  client_id                  = "your-client-id"
  client_secret              = var.oauth_client_secret
  authorization_url          = "https://auth.example.com/authorize"
  token_url                  = "https://auth.example.com/token"
  token_endpoint_auth_method = "client_secret_post"
  grant_type                 = "authorization_code"
  allowed_scopes             = ["read"]
  default_scopes             = ["read"]
}

variable "oauth_client_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `client_id` (String) Client id.
- `display_name` (String) Display name.
- `slug` (String) Unique workspace slug. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `token_endpoint_auth_method` (String) Token endpoint auth method.

### Optional

- `allowed_scopes` (List of String) Allowed scopes.
- `authorization_params` (Map of String) Authorization params.
- `authorization_url` (String) Authorization url.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Write-only OAuth client secret. Removing it clears the stored secret.
- `default_scopes` (List of String) Default scopes. GitHub Apps default to allowed scopes; use an explicit empty list to disable default scopes.
- `grant_type` (String) Grant type.
- `revocation_url` (String) Revocation url.
- `token_params` (Map of String) Token params.
- `token_request_headers` (Map of String, Sensitive) Write-only token and revocation request headers. Removing them clears stored headers.
- `token_url` (String) Token URL. Required except for GitHub Apps, where it defaults to https://api.github.com.
- `workspace_id` (String) Owning workspace ID. Defaults to the provider workspace; changing it replaces the resource.

### Read-Only

- `config_version` (Number) Config version.
- `created_at` (String) Created at.
- `has_client_secret` (Boolean) Has client secret.
- `id` (String) Id.
- `updated_at` (String) Updated at.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import langsmith_auth_server.example <workspace_id>/<id>
```
